description:
Researchers choosing gf2's field types need the representation and strategy choices that the API alone does not explain.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A page under `docs/concepts/` explains the supported field families (GF(2), GF(2^m), GF(p), GF(p^m)), their representations, strategy selection and primitive-polynomial choice, and when each applies, verified against current code, manifests and tests.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its prose and structure are freshly authored; reused items from `crates/gf2-core/docs/GF2M.md` and `PRIMITIVE_POLYNOMIALS.md` are limited to verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and data.
- [hard] REQ-03: It contains no elementary primer, historical narration, migration language, speculation, future promise, marketing language or performance figure.
- [hard] REQ-04: The page is listed in `docs/index.md`, and its links, anchors and citations resolve.
title: Write the finite-field arithmetic concepts page
